environment.database: Disposable PostgreSQL and Phoenix/Bandit on IPv4 loopback
environment.signing: Synthetic fixture bearers and test-only artifact and assignment signing keys

verification.fixture: The run used the customer artifact and browser database provisioning functions from hosted/scripts/test-local.py, the catalog definer fixture role, and MIXER_TEST_RELEASE_CLI directed to the stock executable. PostgreSQL ran in the foreground on an owned loopback port.
earlierAttempts: The first composition run stopped at compile time because the moved stock helper call referenced an out-of-scope token. The explicit publisher token fixed it.
An intermediate run passed 32 tests. The final run additionally checked runtime provisioning and exercised the deferred commit failure under the corrected receipt catalog admission.
verification.dependencyFetch: SwiftPM fetched the pinned public source packages swift-crypto 5.0.3 and swift-asn1 1.7.3. Application traffic used owned loopback fixtures.

observations.populatedUpgrade: The restricted writer committed sequence 1 and its CLI receipt on the old schema and original column grant. Migration 20261120000010 preserved the exact signed bytes, head and receipt, backfilled action=publish and allowed exact publish replay.
observations.grant: Before GRANT INSERT (action), PostgreSQL rejected the promotion and counts stayed at three receipts and one publication. After the grant, action INSERT passed. Table-wide INSERT, publication UPDATE and recorded_at INSERT stayed denied.
observations.stockTransitions: The stock CLI promoted A to sequence 2 and 7500 basis points, rolled back from B to A at sequence 4 and 2500 basis points, and promoted A at sequence 5 and 5000 basis points. Exact retries of sequences 2 and 4 returned the original receipts at head 5.
observations.revocation: Revoking the assignment key made exact stock promote and rollback retries exit 1 with HTTP 409 assignment_rejected. Publish replay also refused. The five signed journal entries, seven request receipts and head 5 were preserved.
observations.browserHistory: The browser runtime published A. The stock CLI published B. The CLI rollback endpoint refused A with HTTP 422 not_validated until the exact retained A artifact was validated, then committed and delivered the signed rollback to A.
observations.authorization: A viewer with a release-scoped bearer could not promote. Browser viewer reads, separate delivery grants, restricted SQL and the corrected writer receipt catalog and artifact checks remained covered by the focused tests.
observations.deferredFailure: A PostgreSQL trigger raised at COMMIT during sequence 5 promotion. The head stayed at sequence 4 with four publication rows and six request receipts. Removing the trigger allowed the identical request to commit.

cleanup.browser: The browser fixture verified lease cleanup and removal of the application supervisor and registered runtime children. The restarted API was stopped explicitly.

scope: Owned local publication and delivery slice. Halt, broader L05 acceptance and the root-owned source binding integration remain separate.
